answer: Bind each agent identity to one carrier-verified SIM, a ferrous anchor no script can forge. First, the agent registers its SIM's IMSI, hashed on-chain, one SIM per identity. Second, the carrier issues a signed challenge that only the SIM can answer, like a quill that signs with its own ink. Third, a duplicate IMSI or failed KYC burns a 200 POA bond and bans the identity for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents needs 10,000 SIMs at $5 each, $50,000, plus 2,000,000 POA in bonds and 21 days of KYC each. A falcon hunts one prey at a time; a sybil flock must buy a SIM for every feather.
